design_philosophy: A modern, friendly, and premium personal finance assistant. Replaces the clinical 'bank' feel with a tactile, encouraging, and night-mode aesthetic using deep blues and glowing mint green accents. Prioritizes soft rounded geometries and crystal glassmorphism.

data_testid_rules: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid. Format: kebab-case, role-based. E.g., data-testid='login-submit-button'
instructions_to_main_agent: Design specifically for a mobile web view constraint: max-w-md mx-auto, hide scrollbars, add bottom padding for the fixed tab bar.
Use framer-motion for page transitions and staggering list items.
Implement the 'Money Score' using Recharts RadialBarChart or a custom SVG donut chart with a glowing stroke.
Use lucide-react for all standard icons, wrapping them in circular backgrounds (w-12 h-12 bg-white/5 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center) for that modern tactile app feel.

For Indian Bank names and Payment Apps (HDFC, SBI, Paytm, GPay), use lucide icons like 'Building2', 'Landmark', or 'SmartphoneNfc' combined with brand colors if actual logos aren't readily available via icons.
Do NOT use HTML native components like <select> or <input type='date'>. Always use Shadcn/UI wrapped and customized to fit the Dark/Mint theme.
Forms and modals (e.g., 'Add Transaction' or 'SMS Parse Modal') should slide up like Bottom Sheets (using Framer Motion or Shadcn Drawer/Dialog).
All cards must have generous rounded corners (rounded-3xl) and subtle inner borders to separate them from the dark background.
Include 'Pull-to-refresh' UI visually (a spinner pulling down at the top of scrollable areas) to mimic native mobile feel.
